name: Michelle Park Steel

offices.t: United States Ambassador to South Korea

summary:
Michelle Eunjoo Steel (née  Park, born June 21, 1955) is an American politician and diplomat who is the U.S. Ambassador to South Korea. Steel was nominated to the position on April 13, 2026 and confirmed by a 55–39 vote of the U.S. Senate on June 17, 2026.
She served as the U.S. representative for California's 45th congressional district from 2023 to 2025, previously representing the 48th congressional district from 2021 to 2023.
